example.title: Bear Creek Bridge, St. Killian Road over Bear Creek
example.place: Town of Buena Vista (Sextonville vicinity), Richland County, WI

brief: Single-span wrought-iron Pratt half-hip pony truss, 41 ft by 13.5 ft, pin-connected: V-laced double-channel top chords, looped eyebar bottom chords and diagonals, X-laced angle verticals, turnbuckle counters and fish-belly floor beams hung on U-bolts, on a concrete deck and abutments. W-beam guardrail is bolted along the inside of both trusses and striped hazard boards stand at the four corners. Carries a one-lane blacktop country road through open farmland over a narrow, reedy creek; a cast builder's plate is bolted to the top chord.
